votes.motion: Approve work session meeting minutes of July 11, 2023, and September 12, 2023, as well as the formal meeting minutes of September 5, 2023; September 12, 2023; and the Legislative Breakfast meeting minutes of January 11, 2023.
votes.description: Approval of multiple prior meeting minutes including work sessions, formal sessions, and a legislative breakfast.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 28 of 2023 with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing October as Italian-American Heritage Month.
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution between the City Council and Mayor recognizing October as Italian-American Heritage Month in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items B-1 and B-2 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on two EPA grant applications from the Department of Public Utilities (Cottonwoods Connection Project and Marcus to Artesian Basin Project) and refers them to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (alley vacations at approximately 2167 South 800 East and 827 East Wilmington Ave).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on two alley vacation ordinance proposals in Council District 7 and defers action to a future Council meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (zoning map amendment at 1018 East 900 South).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezone of 1018 East 900 South from RMF-35 to RMF-30 and defers Council action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 54 of 2023 Text Amendment Related to Maximum Height in the M-1 Light Manufacturing District.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and adopts an ordinance allowing bulk material storage structures up to 150 feet in height west of 5600 West in the M-1 Light Manufacturing District.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Affordable Housing Incentives).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on proposed affordable housing incentive zoning amendments and defers Council action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 55 of 2023 The Anti-Gentrification and -Displacement Plan, Thriving in Place, with a request that the Administration address specified priority items with special urgency and report updated timing estimates by December 1, 2023.
votes.description: Adopts the Thriving in Place anti-displacement and anti-gentrification plan as part of the City's general plan, with direction to the Administration to prioritize specific action items and report back by December 1, 2023.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 56 of 2023 amending the Fiscal Year 2024 Annual Compensation Plan for Non-represented Employees.
votes.description: Clarifies and corrects the FY2024 compensation plan for non-represented City employees, addressing rounding errors, Utah Retirement System contribution updates, and pay grade corrections at the Justice Court.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 57 of 2023 amending the Fiscal Year 2024 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document only for items as shown on the motion sheet.
votes.description: Approves Budget Amendment No. 2 for FY2023-24, including $24.8 million from the Parks, Trails & Open Space bond, a new Planning & Design Division, $2 million in Emergency Rental Assistance funds, and other items.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 58 of 2023 amending chapters 2.02 and 2.84 of the Salt Lake City Code to address changes in Utah law regarding justice courts and establish the Justice Court as an independent branch of government.
votes.description: Amends City Code to comply with a 2023 state law requiring the Justice Court to be independent from the executive and legislative branches of municipal government.

Approves all items on the consent agenda, including setting public hearing dates for multiple ordinances and resolutions, approving Grant Holding Account Batch No. 1 for FY2023-24, and approving multiple board appointments and reappointments.
